5 tasks you shouldn't hand to AI (and what to automate instead)

AI is great at drafts, sorting and formatting. It doesn't know your costs, your clients or the rules where you work. So keep these 5 for yourself: final prices, tax and legal answers, hard news to a client, hiring decisions and facts about your business.

Then hand over the busywork around them. My favorite swap, for tax and legal stuff:

"I run a [TYPE OF BUSINESS] in [STATE/COUNTRY]. I'm meeting my accountant about [TOPIC]. Don't give me tax advice. List the 6 questions I should ask, in plain English, and the documents to bring."

You walk into the meeting prepared, and the professional gives the actual answer.

Same idea for quotes: you type the prices, AI does the layout. For bad news: AI gives you talking points, you say it in your own words.
